notes: Strong disagreement on differential transport of soluble vs membrane aggregates (C79-C86). LLM finds convergent evidence from co-IP, imaging, and quantitative EM sufficient. Peer reviewers question whether expression levels were properly controlled, requesting Western blots to verify protein ratios, indicating the data may not reflect physiological conditions.

Disagreement on collagen secretion data (C69-C71). LLM accepts 92.5±13% secretion as evidence staples don't impair function. Peer reviewers question whether measurements distinguish newly secreted vs previously secreted collagen and request clarification on collagen half-life, indicating uncertainty about experimental validity.

Disagreement on Golgi functionality with staples (C66-C68). LLM finds VSV-G transport and photoactivation kinetics demonstrate normal function. Peer reviewers question whether stapling creates a 'dead Golgi' with transient traffic blocks and request co-transfection efficiency measurements, indicating concerns about experimental interpretation.

Disagreement on cis-Golgi localization specificity (C53-C54). LLM finds immuno-EM with Gm130 (cis) and clathrin (trans) markers clearly demonstrate cis-localization. Peer reviewers note heterogeneity, stating 'some staples may be in cis and others trans' and request explicit discussion of this possibility in the text.

Minimal overlap (only C32 shared). LLM R1 covers broad membrane staple design validation. Peer R3 questions whether some staples might localize to trans-Golgi, requesting acknowledgment of potential heterogeneity. The single shared claim is insufficient for meaningful comparison.

Membrane staple design and characterization (C1-C3, C23-C32) evaluated only by LLM. No corresponding peer review concerns identified for the fundamental staple design, structural reasoning, or EM visualization aspects.

ER staple reversibility (C33-C40) evaluated only by LLM. No corresponding peer review concerns about the demonstration that staples remain static in ER but can be disaggregated and transported upon drug addition.

Temperature block methodology and cis-Golgi localization via lectin assays (C41-C47) evaluated only by LLM. No corresponding peer review concerns about the temperature block approach or lectin precipitation validation.

Staple localization to cisternal centers vs exclusion from rims (C7, C52, C59-C61, C91) evaluated only by LLM. No corresponding peer review concerns about the spatial segregation or dimensional constraint explanation.
20°C staple retention throughout Golgi stack (C55-C56, C62-C65) evaluated only by LLM. No corresponding peer review concerns about the extension demonstrating retention is not cis-specific.

Rim progression model (C9-C10, C93, C108) evaluated only by LLM as UNCERTAIN. LLM notes the model is inferential and lacks direct visualization. No corresponding peer review evaluation of this mechanistic proposal.

Broader conclusions about Golgi transport mechanisms (C87, C92, C94-C99, C104, C107, C110, C112-C113) evaluated only by LLM as UNCERTAIN. LLM notes important caveats and inferential aspects. No corresponding peer review evaluation of these broader mechanistic conclusions.
